title: Local 4-kHz audiogram curvature did not improve frozen cross-cycle balance-failure prediction
abstract: In NHANES adults aged40–69 reaching balance condition4, adding signed bilateral local 4-kHz audiogram curvature to hearing-level and demographic predictors did not establish improved first-trial foam-eyes-closed failure prediction across separate survey cycles: weighted Brier reduction -0.00028714, coefficient-refit two-sample PSU-bootstrap95% interval [-0.00593715, 0.00083863].
